lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the mid-lateral region to the caudal peduncle, with increased inter-blob spacing observed in the posterior third.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a staggered grid pattern, most prominent in the region between the pectoral fin and first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct linear ridges running horizontally; one at the dorsal-lateral transition and one along the mid-lateral line, both displaying a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate distribution of high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin silhouette, with specific clustering along the posterior margin and lower density at the anterior base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular truncation and ragged texture on the apex of the first dorsal fin; attachment of a remora on the ventral-posterior flank near the pelvic region.
other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic caustic light patterns from surface refraction are superimposed across the dorsal surface, creating transient high-luminance noise over the inherent pigmentation.
